concerns.text: User‑story tasks (e.g., T014 [US0] Fetch Real Stimuli, T014b [US0] Verify Stimuli Checksum, T014c [US0] Validate Stimuli Readability, T032 [US2] Fetch Real Meeting Clips, etc.) are placed inside **Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)**. By definition, Phase 2 must contain only core infrastructure that *must* be completed before any user‑story work begins. Embedding US‑level tasks here violates the FR‑010 “foundational‑tasks‑first” ordering rule and prevents the required logical separation of foundational and story work.
